propositions: Bare substring containment in upstream-URL assertion accepts lookalike hosts (prefix-style notpandoc.org and suffix-style pandoc.org.evil.com) that do not actionably point to upstream.
Old assertion 'assert "pandoc.org" in text or "github.com/jgm/pandoc" in text' allows schemeless or malformed URL variants to satisfy GPL source-availability obligation verification.
Scheme and host-anchored regex with negative lookahead end-of-host boundary rejects both prefix and suffix lookalike classes while accepting legitimate NOTICE mentions.
Compiled regex _UPSTREAM_RE with (?![\w.-]) after pandoc\.org and (?![\w-]) after github path prevents false positives on lookalike domains.
Code-scanning alert #88 (py/incomplete-url-substring-sanitization) must be resolved by replacing substring check with anchored regex pattern in the test assertion.
